data.title: 黑歌 · 月光寝榻薄纱睡裙的伸展猫姿
data.description: 夜深月明，黑歌在柔软床铺上舒展身姿，半透明黑色蕾丝睡裙轻拂肌肤，双耳轻抖，如夜猫般娇懒诱人。
data.action: 双手举过头顶舒展伸懒腰，纤腰微挺，猫尾在床单上俏皮划动
data.lighting: 窗外倾泻入内的清冷月光与床头微弱暖黄壁灯烘托轮廓
data.camera: 俯视微倾机位，展现柔韧身体线条与丝绸床品
data.promptProse: Kuroka stretches luxuriously across a vast bed adorned in silver silk sheets, bathed in nocturnal moonlight streaming through tall windows. She wears a tantalizing sheer black lace babydoll negligee that hints at her voluptuous silhouette, her dark cat ears twitching atop wavy obsidian locks while two sleek feline tails sway across the mattress. Golden eyes gleam with playful sensuality as she arches her slender waist.
data.animaCaption: Arching her waist in a lazy feline stretch, Kuroka lounges on the moonlit bed in sheer black lace with twin tails swaying.
